SELECT * FROM gkzh_zyjdc_record
ORDER BY record_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finished, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS winCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'lose' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS loseCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'draw' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS drawCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN role_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS selectedCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(attempt_no), 2), 0) AS avgAttempts FROM gkzh_zyjdc_record

SELECT role_id AS roleId, COUNT(*) AS userCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finishedCount FROM gkzh_zyjdc_record
AND role_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY role_id

SELECT result AS result, COUNT(*) AS userCount FROM gkzh_zyjdc_record
AND result IS NOT NULL GROUP BY result
